#bot.ArmBoth.DownNormal
#bot.Expression.Sad
It’s the first time I went outside with bot after the riots began.
All this madness is mostly over so it should be relatively safe for us to go out.
She had to stay inside my apartment during these riots since I was afraid that some thugs could damage her or even take her away…
But all that is hopefully behind us.
You: Why the sad face? We are out together for the first time in a while.
Bot: I know…{{wi}} It’s just sad that the city we first went out to is no longer here.
You: Well, it’s still here, just a little different.
Bot: That’s true, but it’s not the same.
You: We should go somewhere fun to cheer her up…
